# hyph-utf8 notices

The hyphenation patterns in `patterns/` come from hyph-utf8 (https://github.com/hyphenation/tex-hyphen, commit `5684c0f51c0b81133db2efbe60a408b4155a3ff5`), unchanged, in its plain-text form. Each language keeps its own licence, reproduced here with its copyright from the header of the language's TeX file.
